# 75150 - 2-input line driver

Package DIP-14 · family 751xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75150.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75150.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 44 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75150 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75150.png) | ![75150 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/line-driver2.png) | ![75150 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/line-driver2.png) |

A large open triangle pointing right, inputs A and S on the left.

How to tell it on a drawing: Big triangle without a box = line driver.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | VCC+ | power |  | +12 V |
| 10 | VCC- | power |  | -12 V |
| 5 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 1 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 6 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 7 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 8 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 9 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 14 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 3 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 4 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 2 | S | input |  | strobe common to both drivers |
| 12 | 1Y | output | totem-pole | RS-232-C line output, swings about +/-5..8 V |
| 11 | 2Y | output | totem-pole | RS-232-C line output |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 1Y = NOT (1A AND S) | Datasheet positive logic Y = (AS)'. Inverting RS-232-C driver: output goes to the negative level when A and S are both high. |
| 11 | 2Y = NOT (2A AND S) | Same for driver 2. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 15 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC+ 10.8-13.2 V, VCC- -10.8 to -13.2 V, TA 0-70 C. Applied output voltage max +/-15 V (recommended); withstands short circuit to -25..+25 V. Output levels at RL 3-7 kohm: VOH min 5 V typ 8 V; VOL typ -8 V max -5 V. Inputs TTL/DTL: VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, input voltage 0-5.5 V. Short-circuit current at VO 0 V: 15 mA (VI 3 V), -15 mA (VI 0 V) typical. Slew rate can be set with an external capacitor at the output. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC+ 12 V, VCC- -12 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 7 kohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| A or S | Y | PLH | 60 |
| A or S | Y | PHL | 45 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin |
|---|---|
| transitionTime | Y |

## Not known

- Recommended IOL/IOH are not given (RS-232 line driver; output levels are given into 3-7 kohm instead).
- Maximum propagation delays are not printed (typical only).
- The datasheet's delay table does not say whether the A or the S input was switched.

## Notes

The ND symbol draws one driver (Y = NOT(A AND S)); the package holds two drivers sharing S.

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN75150 dual line driver (bulletin DL-S 7111428, Jan 1971)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 4-68, 4-69 (PDF pages 132, 133); SN75150
